name: float_minimal.k
model:
class FloatMinimal {
  intVal:Int = 42
  f32:Float32 = intVal as Float32
  realBack:Real = f32 as Real

  req realBack > 4.1E1

  req realBack < 4.3E1
}

main:FloatMinimal
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((FloatMinimal (mk-FloatMinimal (intVal Int)(f32 (_ FloatingPoint 8 24))(realBack Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-FloatMinimal (sel-FloatMinimal FloatMinimal))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-FloatMinimal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-FloatMinimal (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-FloatMinimal ((this Ref)) FloatMinimal
  (sel-FloatMinimal (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-FloatMinimal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-FloatMinimal this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class FloatMinimal:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for FloatMinimal.intVal: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal!intVal ((this Ref)) Int
  (intVal (deref-FloatMinimal this))
)

; --- getters for FloatMinimal.f32: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal!f32 ((this Ref)) (_ FloatingPoint 8 24)
  (f32 (deref-FloatMinimal this))
)

; --- getters for FloatMinimal.realBack: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal!realBack ((this Ref)) Real
  (realBack (deref-FloatMinimal this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-FloatMinimal (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class FloatMinimal:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-FloatMinimal FloatMinimal)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (FloatMinimal!intVal this) 42)
)

(assert (! (FloatMinimal.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (FloatMinimal!f32 this) ((_ to_fp 8 24) RNE (to_real (FloatMinimal!intVal this))))
)

(assert (! (FloatMinimal.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (FloatMinimal!realBack this) (fp.to_real (FloatMinimal!f32 this)))
)

(assert (! (FloatMinimal.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (FloatMinimal!realBack this) 41.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (FloatMinimal.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun FloatMinimal.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (FloatMinimal!realBack this) 43.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (FloatMinimal.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-FloatMinimal const-1-FloatMinimal))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-FloatMinimal () FloatMinimal
  (mk-FloatMinimal 42 (fp #b0 #x84 #b01010000000000000000000) 42.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (to_real (intVal (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))))))
  (= (f32 (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1)))
     ((_ to_fp 8 24) roundNearestTiesToEven a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (fp.to_real (f32 (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))))))
  (= (realBack (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (< (realBack (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))) 43.0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-FloatMinimal a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (intVal (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (> (realBack (sel-FloatMinimal (select heap 1))) 41.0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-FloatMinimal
         (mk-FloatMinimal 42 (fp #b0 #x84 #b01010000000000000000000) 42.0))))
